main_body: Multi-storey school building: a green rooftop garden with a parapet above a cream facade of four window rows and a ground-floor glass entrance
top_band: Rooftop seen from above: a light grey parapet rim, then a green planted roof with dark clumps and rooftop units, about rows 0-36, ending in a light front-edge line and a dark green line
evidence: Reading down the middle column, a wide roof surface (green fill inside the grey parapet, with an AC unit, a vent and a skylight on it) clearly reads as a horizontal surface seen from above. A light parapet front edge and a dark line under it separate the roof from the cream facade. The facade has window frames with sills, a floor ledge between storeys and an entrance canopy with a lighter top. The roof is a real foreshortened surface, not a thin rim, so this is 3/4, not a front elevation.

style.evidence: The green roof has several greens with dark clumps and speckle. The cream wall has dotted grain, the glass has diagonal highlights and frame tones, and the brick base is shaded. Outlines lean toward the dark tone of each material (dark teal and grey around the glass, dark green under the roof), not uniform black. The windows repeat the same pattern, so the piece is a little less varied than the tile-roof references, but it is not flat or sticker-like. It would be accepted next to the references.
